decision: Extend two existing canonicals with bounded feed-diagnosis branches; no converter-brand page justified.

primaryReads.supports: Published ICS can be imported without later updates or subscribed to read-only; refresh frequency belongs to recipient provider. No fixed refresh promise adopted.
primaryReads.scope: Targeted publishing sections, not whole page.

primaryReads.supports: Imports are snapshots rather than cross-account synchronization; individual imports and recurrence/conference limitations.
Subscription routes distinguish Google shared access and a published URL added in computer browser.
primaryReads.scope: Full substantive body; no new UI procedure copied.

primaryReads.supports: Discovery of a useful feed-format question and separate refresh stages; root reread. Publisher universal diagnosis/compatibility/no-duplicates and timing claims are not adopted.
primaryReads.scope: Full substantive FAQ, no runtime test.

editorialReasoning: Compare source and recipient, intended dates and zones before changing an actual appointment. Distinguish imported records from subscriptions, permission to share a feed from merely knowing a URL, and intermediate processing from receiving-provider refresh. Do not treat every one-hour mismatch as Windows/IANA parsing or prescribe a conversion service as a guaranteed fix.
